2026-11-30_broad.caption:
Angel Department is a men's clothing brand. We make these videos because looking right starts before you buy anything from anyone, so we teach men how to get it right first.

Dress codes for men explained (part 2 of 3): casual, smart casual, business casual and cocktail, and when you're not sure, go one step above the room. Then the swap system: one base of wide trousers and a fitted knit, and swap one or two pieces for work, a date or a night out.

Part 3: the exact outfits.
